Hare Krishna Prabhuji🙏
Dandwat Pranam

Read the Original & Unedited Books of Vishwaguru His Divine Grace A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupāda.

📖 Every text in this application has been meticulously verified against the original scanned first-edition prints to ensure 100% textual authenticity.

📦 *Note:* The app size is relatively large because it includes Śrīla Prabhupāda's complete collection of books, lectures, morning walks, letters, and conversations.

Please share this with other devotees.

📥 Download As It Is App:
https://github.com/rushhour8/AsItIs-Releases/releases/download/Sp/AsItIs-v1.0-withoutLib.apk
